02
Corrosion-Resistant Build
Engineered with premium materials to withstand harsh coastal, industrial, and outdoor environments. Resistant to salt spray, moisture, UV exposure, and chemical exposure — ensuring consistent conductivity and a long service life even in the most demanding conditions.
03
Plug-and-Play Setup
Pre-fitted MC4 connectors enable instant, tool-free connection between solar panels, inverters, and charge controllers. Simply plug in and power up — no soldering, crimping, or professional installation required, saving both time and labor costs on any project.
04
Universal Compatibility
Designed to integrate seamlessly with all standard MC4-equipped solar panels, hybrid inverters, battery storage systems, and off-grid electrical setups. From small home systems to large commercial arrays, these cables deliver reliable, stable power connections across every component of your renewable energy system.

exactInertRecords.description:
Reliable Circuit Protection for Energy Storage and Backup Systems

The 125A AC Circuit Breaker provides dependable overload and short-circuit protection for residential, commercial, and industrial electrical systems. Designed for use as a Smart Port and Generator Breaker, it helps safeguard critical power equipment while supporting safe and reliable system operation. With a high interrupting capacity, advanced safety features, and compliance with industry standards, this breaker is an essential component for energy storage, backup power, and solar applications.

&nbsp;

&nbsp;

Key Benefits
125A Current Capacity – Designed to support systems requiring up to 125 amps of continuous protection.
Advanced Safety Features – Includes trip-free operation, an indicating handle, and high interrupting capacity for enhanced system safety.
Solar and Energy Storage Ready – Supports applications requiring protection for smart ports, generators, and energy storage system components.
Multiple Protection Functions – Provides protection against PV reverse polarity, over-voltage conditions, and electrical surges.
Versatile Installation Options – Suitable for residential, commercial, industrial, and backup power applications.
&nbsp;

&nbsp;

Use Cases
Ideal for solar energy systems, energy storage installations, backup power systems, generator integration, industrial automation equipment, telecommunications infrastructure, and mobile power applications where dependable circuit protection is required.
&nbsp;

&nbsp;

Tech Specs
Product Type: AC Circuit Breaker
Current Rating: 125A
Rated Voltage: AC 120/240V
Application: Smart Port and Generator Breaker
Protection Functions: Overload Protection, Short Circuit Protection, PV Reverse Polarity Protection, Over-Voltage Protection, Surge Protection

exactInertRecords.name: Enphase IQ System Controller 3 Microgrid Interconnect Device
exactInertRecords.description:
The Enphase IQ System Controller 3 connects the home to grid power, IQ Batteries, and solar PV with microinverters.

&nbsp;

Use IQ System Controller 3 for all new installs using IQ8 Series Microinverters.

&nbsp;

IQ System Controller 3 provides microgrid interconnection device (MID) functionality by automatically detecting and seamlessly transitioning the home energy system from grid power to backup power in the event of a grid failure. It consolidates interconnection equipment into a single enclosure and streamlines grid-independent capabilities of PV, storage by providing a consistent, pre-wired solution for residential applications.

&nbsp;

DOES NOT support Generator Integration

EG4SP18KDLETH — EG4 Ethernet Monitoring Adapter
The EG4SP18KDLETH is an Ethernet monitoring adapter designed to provide stable, wired connectivity for compatible EG4 hybrid inverters. This accessory replaces traditional Wi-Fi monitoring solutions by enabling a direct Ethernet (LAN) connection between the inverter and your local network, offering more reliable, secure, and consistent system monitoring than wireless alternatives.

Key Features

 	
Wired Ethernet Connectivity: Connects the inverter directly to a network via RJ45 Ethernet cable, improving reliability over Wi-Fi and eliminating common wireless signal issues.

 	
Real-Time Monitoring: Supports transmission of performance data to the EG4 monitoring platform (app or web dashboard), providing visibility into system operation, PV production, battery status, and fault reporting.

 	
Plug-and-Play Installation: Easy to install with standard Ethernet cable (568B), mounting hardware included, and status LEDs for network, inverter communications, and IP connectivity.

 	
Improved Data Reliability: By eliminating reliance on Wi-Fi, the adapter ensures consistent data flow for remote diagnostics, performance tracking, and energy management.

 	
Compact &amp; Durable: Designed to integrate seamlessly with EG4 inverters in both residential and commercial installations.

exactInertRecords.description: The IntegraRack IR-T1 TileBallast™ is a groundbreaking tile-roof mounting bracket that requires no tile removal and no roof penetration, offering a fully non-invasive solution for concrete tile roofs. Instead of screwing through tiles, the IR-T1 uses IntegraGel industrial-strength epoxy to bond three overlapping concrete tiles together, leveraging their weight as ballast. This system dramatically speeds up installation (up to 4× faster than traditional tile hooks), while also increasing structural strength. Tested in a wind tunnel at over 165 MPH (3:1 safety factor), the IR-T1 is built to withstand severe wind conditions without compromising roof integrity. It includes an integrated upright mount that supports any rail system, making it highly flexible for solar module installation.

exactInertRecords.name: EQ-24/2 24V Battery Balancer, balances 2 x 12V batteries in series.
exactInertRecords.description:
Application

No two batteries are alike. Batteries in series are only as strong as their weakest link

The EQ 24/2 Battery Equalizer from Watts247.com is essential to balance any series connection of 12V batteries (in 12V/24V/36V/48V etc), regardless of chemistry (Lithium/Gel/- Flood/AGM lead acid)

The battery equalizer will equalize/balance the battery voltage when it detects more than 20mV between two batteries. It will shunt current from one the highest voltage battery to its peers at up to 5A, keeping all the 12V “links” in the chain precisely balanced, always, in all conditions, (Charging/Discharging/Standby) thereby maximizing battery performance, efficiency &amp; lifespan

Example: balancing a fully charged battery (in series with a fully discharged 12V 100 ah battery can take between 20 hours to 200 hours - (depending on voltage difference)

exactInertRecords.description:
Application

No two batteries are alike. Batteries in series are only as strong as their weakest link

The EQ 48/4 Battery Equalizer from Watts247.com is unique and essential to balance any series connection of 2.4V /3.2/6V/9V etc to 12V batteries (in 12V/24V/36V/48V etc), regardless of chemistry (Lithium/Gel/- Flood/AGM lead acid) .

Example, can be used to balance 4 x 3.2V Lithium Cells to make a single 12.8V cell , or 4 x 3.6V cells to make a 14.4V, or 4 x 6V golf cart batteries to make a 24V battery, or 2 x 9V batteries to make 18V, or 2 x 12V to make 36V etc.

Can be daisy chained to make up any voltage battery, and even create your own simple BMS system  (No overload protection or temperature protection as would a standard BMS,  this could be used ONLY to balance cells)
